result.summary: The intersection features a signalized crossing with a marked crosswalk and newly installed sidewalks with ADA-compliant curb ramps. However, the crosswalk markings are significantly faded, and parked vehicles along the curb may obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility 'continental' or 'ladder' patterns to increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to improve sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position.
